name: HYDRA-UMC-STUDIO
notes: Web control dashboard with 3D multi-robot visualization, talking to HYDRA-UMC-SERVER's own API. GamepadController.tsx's real-time actions (joint/table jog, E-STOP, START/STOP, speed) now fire the atomic sendRobotCommand()/POST /api/robot/:id/command path instead of the 500ms-debounced settings save, matching every other real-time control surface in RobotDetail.tsx; jointLimitsFor() moved to the shared examples/robotKinematicsDispatch.ts so both reuse the same per-model joint-limit clamping. `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) was itself a silent no-op against this repo's own solution-style tsconfig - fixed to real `tsc -b --noEmit`, which immediately surfaced and got 8 real pre-existing type errors fixed. tests/ (new, vitest) now covers 145 real cases across src/examples/ and the default-fixture seed - the FK/IK math for all 24 robot models robotKinematicsDispatch.ts fans out to, none of which had a single test before. Example robots/cameras seeded on a fresh install no longer claim a live online/urtcConnected/connected hardware connection they don't have; a new serverReachable signal (real, live, never persisted to settings.json) now drives the System Online/Offline badge instead of a static fixture field.
